title: PLA Sorties Rebound to 3 After Zero-Sortie Day; All Cross Median Line Into N/SW ADIZ Sectors
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 3 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLAN vessels and 7 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24-hour window ending 06:00 (UTC+8) on August 22, 2026 — a rebound from the prior day's zero-sortie reading. All 3 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the northern and southwestern sectors of Taiwan's ADIZ. The full post-Han Kuang 42 sequence now reads: Aug 14: 9 → Aug 15: 4 → Aug 16: 11 → Aug 17: 1 → Aug 18: 5 → Aug 19: 20 → Aug 20: n/a → Aug 21: 0 → Aug 22: 3, continuing the day-to-day fluctuation pattern with no new record since the June 4 all-time high of 32. ROC Armed Forces said they responded with combat air patrol aircraft, naval ships and coastal missile systems.

title: Explosion and Fire at Tainan Waste Site Injures 13
detail: An explosion and fire broke out at approximately 1:12 a.m. on August 22, 2026 at a vacant lot used to store discarded industrial materials on Haidian Road in Tainan's Annan District, southern Taiwan. Preliminary investigation identified aluminum-magnesium alloy and waste oil at the site as contributing factors; the cause remains under investigation. Thirteen people — three firefighters and ten residents — sustained minor injuries (mostly abrasions and burns) and were discharged after treatment; no deaths were reported. The blaze spread to 8-11 neighboring homes and damaged roughly 20 vehicles, including fire trucks, an ambulance and rescue vehicles; dozens of nearby residents were evacuated. Authorities dispatched 53 fire trucks and 144 firefighters, using foam and water cannons to contain the fire. Post-incident air quality monitoring showed no abnormalities.
